title: 검사복무평정규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:8:0:00010:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 8 (Non-Disclosure of Evaluation Results, etc.)
(1) The results of service evaluations shall not be disclosed externally, except for notification of a summary of the results to the person concerned under Article 8-2. Provided, however, that a public official who is responsible for personnel affairs concerning prosecutors and designated by the Minister of Justice may inspect the results to the extent necessary for improving the personnel management system, etc. [Amended on November 30, 2018.]
(2) The results of service evaluations shall not be used for any purpose other than personnel affairs.
